caption: The drawing consists of three main sections arranged within outlined rectangles on a cream-colored background. In the center lower section is a detailed, colored rendering of a jug, shaped and textured to resemble a tree trunk with knots, grooves, and branch-like protrusions, forming the handle and part of the decorative surface. The jug is primarily brown with variations of darker and lighter shades, and has hints of yellow, green, and reddish tones, emulating the appearance of bark and wood with natural highlights and shadows. To the left and right above the central image are two line drawings, each enclosed in a square. The left line drawing shows the jug in a frontal view with simplified contours and visible branch motifs, while the right line drawing shows the jug in a profile or three-quarter view, including the handle and the same decorative motifs. Both line drawings are monochrome, using only black outlines, and omit color or shading. The overall composition is clean, organized, and symmetrical, with all object depictions centered and separated by fine lines.
title: Pitcher (Individual Creamer)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
